posts.title: At the Pokémon Championships I found out something more
posts.description: Well, it happened. Pokémon Champions came out recently and I took the opportunity to bring myself to the Turin Special Championships event. I knew it would have been tough because I didn’t play Pokémon VGC that seriously in 6 long years, and it has been tough indeed because I also met a lot of skillful opponents and I had my fair share of bad luck, but in the end that’s not really what I’m going to talk about here.

posts.title: Why I don't like people who bash Pokémon in the Nintendo Switch era
posts.description: It’s really easy to pick on Pokémon in the recent years. From the outside, you see a multi-billion company that every single time fails to deliver a game that other titles in the same category like Zelda, Xenoblade and even ripoffs like Palworld seem to get right. I can see why these people are mad: they play the mainline videogame for the adventure, expecting something epic and then they shelf the game back in their library when they are done, waiting for the next one, or maybe they just stop playing Pokémon because they feel that they can get a better experience from some other RPG-style game.

posts.title: A net made of chains
posts.description: I spent several years pooping on VPNs and telling my friends that those are really useless. I think something else is needed to make the internet a better experience, but these days I decided to try a VPN… and my opinion didn’t change. Why do people use VPNs? Why do they spend a chunk of money every month for an optional service, thinking that VPNs will put a band-aid over their bad use of the internet?
